protocol.registered: 2026-10-16, written before any call; analysis plan fixed here
protocol.tool: Jev (TypeSafe System One, model jev-latest) via its HTTPS API, one yes/no (noul) question per state
protocol.design: full factorial closure 2 x coalition 4 x war 2 x unrest 2 x ecology 2 = 64 cells, 3 paraphrases each (reworded sentences, permuted order) = 192 calls. Setting, coalition, resistance and the absent ideology reuse the v6 grid sentences. The ideology is absent at the start of every state

questions.id9: Within the next 9 years, a doctrine that the human population should be greatly reduced, justified by ecological limits or by making way for AI successors, takes hold among the ruling group.

analysis: cell value = mean over 3 paraphrases; report paraphrase spread (median and 90th percentile of max-min)
baseline p_id (model: P(uptake within 9 y) after closure, no war, calm, normal ecology) = mean over coalitions of the closed, no-war, calm, normal-ecology cells
ratios against that baseline, averaged over the other factors: war (model x2.5), insurgency (model m_unrest U(1.5, 3)), severe ecology (model up to x1.5), no closure (model x0.1)
logistic least squares on the logit of cell means with one-hot factors; report coefficients

v7 prior: if the Jev baseline lies outside the v6 prior's 80% interval (lognormal median 0.045, sigma 0.6: 0.021-0.098), replace the prior by an evidence mixture (as for pr_red): weight 0.5 on v6, 0.5 on a lognormal at the Jev baseline with sigma 0.6. Ratios are reported against the model's multipliers, not substituted
no cells dropped; no re-wording after seeing results
